hooks.command: [ -r "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.sh" ] && sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.sh" || { rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 2 ] || printf '%s\n' "agent-guard: the guard hook did not return a decision (rc $rc) - blocked; stop and tell the human (usual cause: the session was not started in the repository root; see docs/operations/runtime-guards.md, Is the guard loaded?)" >&2; exit 2; }
